name: Cursed Arche
desc: A longbow with arrows made to match. Distant targets get shot through, while those closer at hand get a much clearer look at the razor-sharp arrowheads, which can be wielded like knives.

eff.name: Blizzard Arrow
eff.desc1: Deals [7 + (Lv. x 7)] power ice and air damage and lowers Negative Effect resistance by [Lv. x 10]%.
eff.desc2: Deals [7 + (Lv. x 7)] power ice and air damage and reduces DEF by [Lv. x 10]%.

eff.name: Bowstring of Disorder
eff.desc1: Increases damage by [Lv. x 3]% if the target has 5 or more negative effects.

eff.name: Maintained Focus
eff.desc1: Grants a [Lv. x 3]% chance to use a consumable without reducing its number of uses.
